title: Chicken Enchilada Skillet
shortDescription: One-pan shredded chicken with tortillas, enchilada sauce, and cheese
subtitle: One-pan shredded chicken with tortillas, enchilada sauce, and cheese
description: Shredded chicken simmers with black beans, corn, enchilada sauce, and torn tortillas, topped with melted cheese for a deconstructed enchilada skillet.

steps.title: Poach and shred chicken
steps.instruction: Simmer chicken in salted water 15–18 minutes until 165°F. Rest, shred into bite-size strands that hold together when sauced.

steps.title: Sweat onion and spices
steps.instruction: Sauté onion in a large skillet 5 minutes until soft. Add garlic, chili powder, and cumin; cook 1 minute until fragrant and toasty.

steps.title: Simmer filling
steps.instruction: Add enchilada sauce, beans, corn, green chiles, and shredded chicken. Simmer 10 minutes until mixture thickens slightly and smells rich.

steps.title: Add tortilla strips
steps.instruction: Stir in tortilla strips, simmer 5 minutes until they soften and absorb sauce like dumplings, not dissolve into paste.

steps.title: Melt cheese and serve
steps.instruction: Remove from heat, top with cheese, cover 3 minutes until melted and glossy. Skillet should look bubbly at edges, not dry.

proTips: Use two skillets if your largest pan cannot fit eight portions comfortably.
Top with avocado and cilantro at the line for fresh contrast.
Green enchilada sauce swap works for milder, tangier flavor.
tonightSpread: Greek yogurt instead of sour cream.
leftovers: Reheat covered with extra sauce to restore moisture.
Scoop into burritos with rice next day.
whyCrewsLikeIt: All the comfort of enchiladas with half the prep. One skillet from stove to table.
mealPrepNotes: Poach and shred chicken ahead. Use corn tortillas torn—not flour—for better texture. Station: Tear tortillas into strips—they thicken sauce like dumplings. Station: Add cheese off heat and cover so it melts without oil separating. Station: Serve straight from skillet with toppings bar adjacent.
